title: Check a new customer's BVN before onboarding
summary: When a customer applies, look up their BVN with Dojah; welcome them if the name matches, otherwise flag it to you.
description: Gives your application form a signed web address. Each applicant (first name, last name, phone, BVN) is checked against the BVN record with Dojah. If the last name matches, they get a welcome SMS; if not, the owner gets an email to review the application by hand. The BVN is personal data: it is sealed in run history and never shown in messages. The owner's email is the tenant variable owner_email.

variables.name: owner_email
variables.why: Where applications that need a manual review are sent.

params.name: path
params.title: Web address path
params.description: The path your application form calls.

params.name: dojah_connection
params.title: Dojah connection
params.description: The name of your Dojah connection.

params.name: sms_connection
params.title: Termii connection
params.description: The name of your Termii connection.

params.name: gmail_connection
params.title: Gmail connection
params.description: The mailbox the review email is sent from.

input.sms: ='Welcome, ' + trigger.body.first_name + '! Your identity check with ' + steps.settings.output.business_name + ' is complete.'

steps.name: Email the owner to review the application

input.subject: ='Application ' + trigger.body.application_id + ' needs a manual KYC review'
input.text: ='The name on application ' + trigger.body.application_id + ' does not match its BVN record. Review it in Taskiem before onboarding the customer.'
